messages:
Samir (eng-security): Auditor (Deloitte) pinged. They want a handover bundle by EOD Thu: RBAC change history (12mo), service-account key rotation proof, KMS envelope usage logs, SIEM exports around incident-381, vuln triage timeline for CVE-2025-XXXX. @Joan @Lucy please coordinate.
Joan (infra): On it. I can pull AuthZ audit + CloudTrail. Where should I drop the package? s3://redwood-audit-packages/inspection-2123/ ok?
Lucy (compliance): That path works. Also include a control-mapping spreadsheet that ties each artifact to SOC2/ISO control IDs — I have a template.
Samir (eng-security): Auditor specifically asked for diffs of rolebindings (not just current snapshot). Can we export rolebinding change events and PR references?
Joan (infra): Yes. I'll run CloudTrail/Stackdriver lookup + our internal `rbac-audit` diff: `rbac-audit export --since 2024-03-01 --format ndjson` and include PR IDs.
Oscar (sre): For KMS, I'll pull crypto_key usage logs: e.g. filter `resource.type="kms_crypto_key" AND protoPayload.methodName:Encrypt` and export to NDJSON. Rotation manifests have timestamps in `kms/rotation-manifests/`.
Joan (infra): Note: service-account key rotation happened Feb 2025. There was an emergency manual key created 2025-09-12 for incident-381 — that is documented in the incident writeup. I'll include the rationale and the rotation proof (key IDs + rotation timestamps).
Samir (eng-security): Auditor also wants proof that logs are immutable (90d) + integrity hashes. Where are SIEM snapshots stored?
Oscar (sre): SIEM exports are under /opt/siem/exports/ and synced to S3 with Object Lock. Example export I ran: `ndjson-cat logs | gzip > export-20250912.gz && sha256sum export-20250912.gz > export-20250912.gz.sha256`. I'll include the sha256 files and S3 object version metadata.
Lucy (compliance): I'll take the artifacts and map them: control_id, artifact_path, assertion, owner. I'll update `controls-mapping-sample.xlsx` and push to `git::compliance/control-docs`.
Samir (eng-security): Auditor Q: "How do you validate third-party dependency patches were deployed to prod after triage?" We should attach PR -> CI -> deploy trace example.
Joan (infra): I'll include CircleCI job logs and deploy manifest: `circleci/jobs/12345.log` and `k8s/deployments/service-a@v1.2.3.yaml`. Also will add the canary rollout screenshots and the rollback policy snippet.
Oscar (sre): FYI there's a note: low-severity vendor vuln patched in codebase but backport missed on 2 nodes due to drift. See `vuln-triage/20250920-drift-note.md` — includes mitigation and timeline. I'll include that and the node remediation evidence.
Samir (eng-security): Auditor requires chain-of-custody on exports. We'll sign the manifest. Use `gpg --detach-sign manifest.json`. Joan, can you sign the package after packaging?
Joan (infra): Yes, I'll run the package job and sign. Starting packaging now.
audit-bot: Packaging job started for s3://redwood-audit-packages/inspection-2123/artifact-20260320.tar.gz
Joan (infra): Packaging complete. Signed manifest attached. Uploading artifact to s3://redwood-audit-packages/inspection-2123/artifact-20260320.tar.gz.sig
audit-bot: Packaging job completed. artifact URL: s3://redwood-audit-packages/inspection-2123/artifact-20260320.tar.gz (signed)
Lucy (compliance): I'll stitch the control narrative and the mapping sheet, then send to the auditor for initial review. @Samir please review before we hand off.
Samir (eng-security): Thanks everyone. I'll review the narrative and the sample CI->deploy trace. If auditor asks for sample queries or copies of the raw NDJSON logs, we'll provide controlled extracts. Deadline Thu EOD.
